admission.owner_condition: Pursue new dataflow architecture only if credible path to pure AR similar to HBM AND MTP on par with HBM. Old approximately707us adaptation rejected. Architecture first; no RTL/build admission from this artifact.
admission.interpretation: Strict no-slower reference is sufficient for both similar/on-par. No arbitrary5/10% tolerance attributed to owner. Candidates slightly slower can be reported for decision, never automatically admitted by relaxing threshold.
credible_path_requirements: Complete native draft+P6verify+seed+commit/rollback execution schedule, not ROM capacity-only accounting.
Per-position outputs, real expert unions and all finite ports accounted in selected cluster/die topology.
Every new latency-saving mechanism has source-compatible arithmetic and specific full-shape validation path; unqualified mechanisms labelled assumptions with nonzero cost/sensitivity.
Use conservative achievable service/physical area/routing constraints; do not pass only by unmatched acceptance or zero missing terms.
Matched total silicon including HBMDRAM and power budgets reported, preserving operation/precision/context/golden contract.

drafter_identity.baseline_algorithm: DSpark released mtp.0..2 stages over5positions, shared head, serial Markovbias tokenfeedback. These are named mtp.* in checkpoint but do not justify substituting generic one-token nativeMTP.
checkpoint_binding: Pin main checkpoint revision/index and exact mtp tensors, noise token and DSpark blocksize5/n_mtp3 configuration.
Pin sharedembedding/head and Markovembed/head payloads; all three drafter stages resident/reachable.
Reduced-v2 seeded checkpoint validates mechanism only, not release acceptance.
If using another drafter, native MTP or altered precision, do not import tau3.8879; use matched published acceptance or label performance unknown.
required_order: Consume verified anchor hidden states and token.
Embed [y,noise,noise,noise,noise]; three full DSpark stages including attention over retained window plus all blockrows.
Compute five full logitrows once if actual buffers retain them.
Five serial Markov matvec+bias+argmax steps with actual previous RTL-produced token.
Use drafttokens in causal main-model P6 verify.
Determine accepted prefix and bonus/correction, seed only permitted committedstate, retire suffix and make next iteration executable.
drafter_identity.head_cost: Five-column LM head and five serial Markovheads both charged; do not assume six independent ARheads, nor omit Markov serial feedback.

verify_contract.causality: Main verify each position attends only permitted committed history and preceding speculativepositions; DSpark all-block attention differs and must not leak into main verify.
verify_contract.expertunion: For each layer derive expertIDs and weights perposition. U=union of six sets; repeated6 lowerbound, disjoint36 upperbound when6selected among384. Every expert computes only validposition masks; golden expert accumulation order perposition maintained.
verify_contract.NC_contract: NC1/2/4/6 is physical lane/capacity choice. Each weight may serve multiplepositions only when operands/masks/accumulators and ports exist; extra passes for ceil(activepositions/NC) and row/group overhead explicit. NC1 cannot get P6 free.
required_outputs: All six verify positions have exact logits or equivalent exact greedy argmax before acceptance.
Perposition hiddenstates required by drafterseed retained/provided, not discarded after head.
Layer mainwindow/compressedKV/index/candidate/Engram state updates retained with position/session/generation identity.
verify_contract.barrier: Price norm/quantization, selection, expertfetch and gathers per actual dependencies; LOCAL_REPEAT cannot substitute for explicit newdataflow schedule.

operations: Publish speculativerows only to causally allowed readers; retain overwrittenring data or use shadow slots.
Accept contiguous prefix a in0..5 plus exact bonus/correction token semantics.
Invalidate rejected suffix across every replica; quarantine outstanding returns until drained.
Commit metadata and caches atomically in executionorder; no premature ring reuse.
Seed drafter according to actual committedmainhidden availability; bonusgenerated token may require subsequent consumption before its KV exists.
Start next iteration and show state equals non-speculativegolden; checkpointed count alone is insufficient.
mutable_state_contract.minimal_validation_after_architecture_ad: Smallest complete state-service/iteration mechanism with forced acceptedprefix0..5, ringwrap, late responses, retry/reset/genwrap where supported, and at least nextiteration reuse; whole-array simulation unnecessary.
mutable_state_contract.cost_rule: Positive latency/traffic/storage for copy or shadowcommit, fences, cancellation and remaining response drain; overlap only backed by schedule and capacity.

useful_output_metric.formula: useful_tok_s = E[committed prefix + bonus/correction] * 1e6 / E[draft_us + causal_verify_us + seed_us + commit_rollback_us + unhidden_transport_us]
useful_output_metric.numerator: Only user-visible tokens irrevocably committed exactly as golden; not proposed5, verified6, totalMACcolumns or rawheadoutputs.
useful_output_metric.bonus: tau3.8879 already includes bonus; never add1 again or multiply by6.
useful_output_metric.matched_tau_ratio: At same tau, MTP rate parity is simply new_step<=reference_step. Published tau uncertainty does not excuse slowerstep.
